text:
Nina H.: Account health alert for BetaCorp. renewal conversation next week. Need a short 'what the eng team can try now' note. prefer one-screen Slack-friendly checklist.
Ravi T.: I'll make a compact checklist. include prefills, streaming fallback, batching & a metric curl.
Keiko M.: please also include the minimal SRE triggers we use internally and the exact metric names (so customers can paste them).
ops-bot: Template created: https://console.redwood.ai/templates/betacorp-checklist :link:

Ravi T.: CHECKLIST: "BetaCorp Quick Stabilize"
- Verify pinned model and streaming connectivity: `GET /v1/tenants/<TID>`
- Warmup/prefill: 15 short deterministic prompts over 5 mins; keep <= 12 tokens each.
- Client defaults: batchWindowMs=50, maxConcurrency=5, streamStallMs=1300, resumeMaxTokens=40.
- Streaming fallback: try one resume then poll 3x at 300ms, then escalate to support. log `stream_fallback` event.
- Metrics to paste: active_sessions (5m), avg_token_latency_ms (5m), prefix_cache_hit_rate (5m), error_rate_percent (5m).

Keiko M.: Internal trigger: if avg_token_latency_ms > 240 AND prefix_cache_hit_rate < 42 for 15m -> LEVEL2. Also page SRE if error_rate_percent > 3% or any 5xx spike.

Nina H.: Great. can we add the curl for customers?

Ravi T.: Added:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  "https://metrics.redwood.ai/tenants/<TENANT_ID>/window?m=active_sessions,avg_token_latency_ms,prefix_cache_hit_rate,error_rate_percent&window=5m"
```

Keiko M.: Also note we set `x-rd-fallback-model` header when routing to a smaller variant if pools are saturated. Customers should paste header if present.

Nina H.: I'll send to the AE and ask them to run the checklist. tagging @Ravi to help if needed.

ops-bot: Checklist saved to /docs/onboarding/checklists/betacorp-quick-stabilize-v1 :white_check_mark:
